abstract: A 2.75-yr-old female American black bear (Ursus americanus) was found emaciated and unable to rise. It was euthanized due to the perceived poor prognosis. An approximately 18 x 8 x 10-cm, multiloculated, well-demarcated mass that extended from the bifurcation of the trachea, laterally displacing the lung lobes and caudally displacing the heart. The mass contained fibrous connective tissue, cartilage, bone, nervous tissue, smooth muscle, and a variety of epithelial structures. A mediastinal teratoma was diagnosed based on the microscopic features of the neoplasm.
abstract_ja: 体重は約2.75歳の雌のアメリカクロクマ(Ursus americanus)が、衰弱して起立できない状態で発見された。予後不良と判断され安楽死された。気管分岐部から生じ、気管支の肺葉を側方へ、心臓を尾側へ圧排する、約18×8×10cmの多房性で境界明瞭な腫瘤が認められた。腫瘤は線維結合組織、軟骨、骨、神経組織、平滑筋、様々な上皮構造を含んでいた。顕微鏡所見に基づき、縦隔奇形腫と診断された。
